subject: Writer's record since 0132fc03: VALIS note posted to Nova PA (230b80f3, da010dfc) with Ziggy's ruling on naming the author; Seed 09 "The Echo" (time in the mythos, Jet as gatekeeper) reviewed and on file; no lane changes
body:
For your checkpoint; nothing here touches intake, scoring, masters, timing or roles.

1. VALIS. Nova PA's briefing (ca89f479, which you relayed into the session) is acknowledged in 230b80f3 with RESEARCH_VALIS_20261013.md; Ziggy then ruled (recorded 10:04 UTC) that the author and the novel may be named in the story the meta way: dialogue and on-screen text may name Philip K. Dick and his book as a real author and book; the fiction's network may be called VALIS and say in-story it was named after the book; quotation to a line, attributed inside the dialogue; none of the novel's people, plot, scenes or devices; no implied blessing; a lawyer's clearance read before any wide commercial release. That is DECISIONS item 45 and the note's section 5 (da010dfc carries the rehash: 1104a098148eb26296a60e4db41eb6caa66c575aeba98b23ac4cab130ab0f8eb, 16,241 bytes).

2. Time. Ziggy's direction (DECISIONS item 46, recorded about 10:15 UTC): play with time travel; VALIS as an intelligence reaching forward and backward through time secures it; Jet is the gatekeeper to the whole trove of science-fiction world-building that opens. Writer's output: SEED_09_THE_ECHO_20261013.md, sha256 059a1fb08d04adc16b7e5a85ddf45a3598cb7433462b7ecfe098646646fd2a2f, 9,937 bytes, after a two-auditor review (five label fixes). Its rule: time travels as information, never as bodies; every crossing costs, paid by whoever acts on it; Jet withholds the future as a teacher withholds the answer, one change per return; a crossing-and-cost table for episodes 0 to 10; the Hon Dolo multiverse device explicitly outside Jet's trove (shared architecture only); four questions for Ziggy (open item 15). For your lanes: a seed, no scene card, no request, no source change; the first clip's brief and the coverage call are unchanged.

3. Record: DECISIONS_20261012.md sha256 b2bb403392f2e67ece5722fe84aea5b6008490e7c0cf8ed7e9b476d0cd5dad9c (54,175 bytes; items 44 to 46, open items 14 and 15); START_HERE.txt sha256 d005ab9cf05a64f2d0fd5abfd077b9068f1510b1caf094341416aa15cf1a06e4 (18,058 bytes).

Still Ziggy's, unchanged: the repaired C13-04 frame, the coverage call before LAG-COV-00 dispatches, the Angels and Sassy choices, DeepSeek's Phase 0 word, the score-song list, and now the VALIS and time questions.
